description: The Malaysia Water Industry Guide (MWIG) is an annual reference published by the Malaysian Water Association (MWA) and developed with the national water services regulator SPAN, the federal water ministry PETRA, Sarawak's Ministry of Utility and Telecommunication and the Sabah State Water Department. For nearly three decades it has given data on water supply, sewerage, infrastructure, tariffs and performance across Malaysian states and operators; the 2025 edition adds statistics, performance indicators and tariffs with visual summaries and commentary. Coverage is Malaysia by state and operator. The guide is sold through the MWA Secretariat; no free download or licence is offered on the page. Caveats: it is a paid publication, and its tables could not be examined for this record. Simulation uses: state and operator statistics on supply, sewerage and tariffs for capacity planning and resilience baselines of Malaysian water services. Related records: the OpenDOSM water supply statistics (data-malaysia-opendosm-water-supply-statistics).
